user.title: Connect your ESB Networks account
user.description: Download your meter history automatically. Your credentials remain in Home Assistant.

error.invalid_auth: ESB rejected the credentials. Check your account details.
error.browser_verification_required: ESB requires browser verification. Sign in on the ESB website and try again later. This integration cannot solve CAPTCHA.
error.login_cooldown: Please wait between login attempts. Allow at least one minute between attempts; after three attempts within 15 minutes, wait for the oldest attempt to expire.
error.different_meter: The downloaded meter does not match this configuration.
error.cannot_connect: Could not retrieve valid meter data. Try again later.
error.network_error: Could not reach ESB Networks. Check network access and try later.
error.login_page_changed: The ESB sign-in page was not recognised. Check the HA logs for the safe error code.
error.missing_auth_form: ESB did not complete sign-in. Browser verification or a portal change may be involved.
error.session_expired: ESB did not establish a usable session after login. Try later.
error.portal_http_error: ESB returned an HTTP error. Try later.
error.portal_rate_limited: ESB is limiting requests. Wait before retrying.

init.title: Meter data options
init.description: Optional: select cumulative grid import/export energy sensors with recorder history. Comparisons use matching complete Irish days. Positive difference means the reference measured more than ESB. Clear a source to disable its comparison.
